description: Track verification evidence and check it before Codex finishes.

hooks.command: if [ -n "${PLUGIN_DATA:-}" ]; then runtime_dir="$PLUGIN_DATA/runtime"; runtime="$runtime_dir/doneguard.py"; if [ -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/doneguard.py" ]; then mkdir -p "$runtime_dir" && temporary="$runtime.$$" && cp "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/doneguard.py" "$temporary" && mv "$temporary" "$runtime"; fi; if [ -f "$runtime" ]; then python3 "$runtime" hook; fi; elif [ -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/doneguard.py" ]; then python3 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/doneguard.py" hook; fi
